plot: At 9 p.m. on the dinner table Pim proudly accepts a fancy dinner invitation from Mr. Pot; Lolly insists on good manners until Crispy, hiding under the table, shows them the menu says Fried Dough Bros, Lolly's tablecloth trick sends Mr. Pot spinning across the table, they politely thank him and escape, and the sixth name card is for The Thing on the Roof.

script.title: Never Say Yes to Mr. Pot's Dinner

beats.say: A letter! A fancy letter! With a wax seal! Somebody finally likes me!
Gimme! Ooh, gold ink. You are invited to dinner. Tonight. Dress nice.
Who signed it? Please say the tooth fairy. Please say anybody nice.
Uh... it says... Love, Mister Pot.
Nine o'clock, on the big dinner table. Candles. Napkins. And one very, very polite cauldron.
Welcome, welcome, my little guests. Sit. Please. Make yourselves... comfortable.
Statistically, a villain who says please is ninety-nine percent more dangerous.
Manners are manners, Zeek. If he is polite, we are polite. Pim, napkin on your lap.
I don't HAVE a lap! I'm a bean! I'm all lap! Or no lap! I don't know!
Ha ha. Funny bean. Funny beans are always... the juiciest.
Did he just say juiciest? Lolly. Lolly! He said juiciest!
He meant juicy jokes, sweetie. Sit up straight and smile.
First course. A big bowl of hot oil... with no soup in it.
Excuse me, sir. I see bowls, I see forks, I see oil. Where exactly is the food?
The food... is coming. The food... is already here.
Psst. Under the table. Read the little menu card.
Crispy?! Why are you hiding under the table?
I do not sit at his table. Not ever again. Read it.
Main dish. Fried Dough Bros. Serves one pot. ...WE are the dinner!
Stay calm. Nobody leaves a dinner party rudely. We leave politely.
How do you leave POLITELY from being FRIED?! Is there a fork rule for this? A napkin rule?
Second course! Time to FRY!
Mister Pot, before we fry, may I show you a little party trick?
A trick? ...I love tricks. Nobody ever shows me tricks. The toaster only shows me toast.
I pull the tablecloth really fast, and everything on the table stays perfectly still. Ready?
She has never done this before. The odds are terrible. Like, three percent.
Three... two... TABLECLOTH!
The candles stay. The plates stay. Mister Pot does not stay. He spins across the table like a giant top.
Wheee- WHY am I spinning?! Somebody stop the table!
It worked! Everybody, down the table leg! Go, go, go!
Wait! Lolly! We didn't say thank you for dinner!
Oh, you're right. Thank you for having us, Mister Pot! The oil was lovely!
Come back... I made dessert... it's crème brûlée... with YOU on top...
Never eat his dessert. Never. I ate it once. Look at me now.
Safe on the floor, Pim looks back up at the table. Six chairs. Six little name cards.
Five of them are ours. Bup, Zeek, Lolly, Crispy, and me.
Then who is the sixth seat for? Mister Pot does not have any friends.
It just says... The Thing on the Roof.
The thing on the roof is coming to DINNER?!
